Yes: a scalar coarse variable Y = LX of a VAR(1) on ℝⁿ is an ARMA process of orders at most (n, n − 1). Its Mori–Zwanzig memory is non-zero at every lag in general, but finitely many coordinates, built from Y's own past and innovations, carry it exactly. Other classes, error in terms of the eliminated spectrum, and the ruling on levels stay with [QUESTION-222](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-222.md). | Answered |
| [QUESTION-252](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-252.md) v6 | For the conditions an effective description is asked to meet (predictive sufficiency for a declared target, dynamical independence of the omitted variables, memory closure under a declared projection, approximation fidelity in a declared metric and horizon, and tractability within a declared budget), which can fail while all the others hold, and which such configurations are impossible in which model classes? | The owner's idea at U3 of the exchange of 2026-10-20: "what if we censor or negate each virtue one at a time? that reduces our combinations from n! to n." A3 corrected the count (2ⁿ presence/absence configurations, not n!) and fixed five conditions, asking whether each leave-one-out case is realizable: "An impossible configuration is itself a substantive result." The record holds pairwise non-implications only, none a leave-one-out witness: [CLAIM-389](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-389.md) gives zero memory without independence in VAR(1), [CLAIM-304](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-304.md) retention without feasible recovery. A4 and A5 then found that some conditions are parameters rather than conditions ([CLAIM-401](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-401.md)); that part is QUESTION-324, Answered. The same form as [QUESTION-093](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-093.md) and [QUESTION-115](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-115.md), on a new list. | Open |
| [QUESTION-253](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-253.md) v5 | In the coupled meaning–authority model, is authority's effect on what becomes legible as evidence a third channel beside β and γ, a slower variable with an instability condition of its own, or is it already the commitment regime's κ′, how far the prevailing interpretation bends the reading of the evidence? | A22 §4 of the exchange of 2026-10-20, on the owner's U22 (legibility): "Authority can affect not merely how evidence is interpreted, but which facts become legible enough to count as evidence at all." A22's own caption: "The additional legibility layer is not a separately validated dynamical model." The record's model has two arrows ([CLAIM-330](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-330.md)) and a weight on the reading of evidence ([CLAIM-340](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-340.md)). This asks whether legibility adds a third state or renames the weight. It is the place where the record's mathematics can test the owner's new concept. | Answered |
| [QUESTION-262](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-262.md) v4 | When cooperation across a relation's prevailing perspective changes how one party takes the other, does it change only the state of that party's interpretive organization or also its coupling, how far outcomes may revise the governing interpretation, and can taking part be told experimentally from receiving information of equal favourable content? | From the exchange of 2026-10-22, "Ben Franklin Effect Explained", A5: "One could ask whether a perspectival invitation changes only the initial state of the system, or also changes the coupling parameters". It refines the first half of [QUESTION-259](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-259.md), how perspectives are generated and transformed, to one mechanism, [CLAIM-430](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-430.md)'s invitation, and one distinction, [CLAIM-429](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-429.md)'s state against coupling. | Open |
| [QUESTION-273](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-273.md) v2 | With one population of perspectives, do the three ways of giving them influence that the owner proposed (neighbourhoods in a space whose radii others can change, a shared channel into which they emit at rates, and a budget of passes or locations at which each may act on a common representation) produce different collective decision regimes, and how far does each mechanism's nominal resource predict the counterfactual influence a perspective actually has? | The owner, at U33 of the exchange of 2026-10-24, continued. It is the third appearance of the owner's own model: on 2026-10-13, U1 was "a population of denoisers, each of which has different reach, salience valuation, translation (motion across canvas) rate, influence strength" and U2 the influence canvas ([CLAIM-285](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-285.md), [TERM-053](../../../record/terms.d/TERM-053.md)). The owner took up the build from U37. | Open |
| [QUESTION-281](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-281.md) | By which dynamical transitions do the distinctions individuation needs come into being and pass away (instability that amplifies small differences, nucleation across a finite barrier from a locally stable state, bifurcation of the set of attractors, noise- or rate-induced tipping), and are a form's creation, its stabilization and its coming to have a constitutive role three separate achievements? | The owner's U14 of the exchange of 2026-10-27: "does this elucidate other work we should account for? maybe in the neighborhood of dynamics? bifurcation/catastrophe theory? far from equilibrium dynamics? pattern formation?" A14 found the record well stocked on Turing, Prigogine and Cross–Hohenberg and named the gap as what comes after an instability. It ended on "the mechanisms that create a form, the mechanisms that stabilize it, and the mechanisms through which it acquires a constitutive or autonomous role. Those may turn out to be three different achievements." The record's individuation claims say when a form is one system and how long it lasts ([QUESTION-035](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-035.md)); none says how it begins or ends. An answer names, for a stated system, the transition that made the form and the one that would unmake it. | Open |
| [QUESTION-282](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-282.md) | Under what conditions do interactions change the physically operative correspondence structure among systems (the compatibility operator itself, not only the states it relates), rather than merely reveal it to a measurement or redescribe it in a model? | Raised at the owner's review of the pull request that filed the exchange "Field Existence Question", which called it "one of the genuinely unfinished parts of the program". The formal results the record now holds take the correspondence structure as input. A sheaf's restriction maps, a gauge connection, a port condition and a Laplacian are given, and the mathematics says what follows. [CLAIM-471](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-471.md)'s strong thesis is that interactions can make or change that structure. Only one model the record has read changes it through interaction, and there agreement is reached by learning to lie. The question asks for conditions under which the operative structure changes, with a way to tell that change from discovery and from redescription. | Open |
| [QUESTION-287](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-287.md) | In a deterministic singularly perturbed system whose eliminated variable is fast and contracting and whose reduced system is contracting, does the memoryless quasi-steady-state reduction predict the coarse variable with an error bounded uniformly in time in terms of the eliminated dynamics? | The fast contracting case of [QUESTION-222](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-222.md), split off by the status review of 2026-10-27 under [ADR-049](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-049.md), because [THEORY-773](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-773.md) (Active) settles it. No memory coordinate is needed: the reduction on the slow manifold stays within O(ε) of the true slow trajectory for all t ≥ 0, with every constant explicit, set by the fast contraction rate λ_z, the reduced contraction rate λ_x and the manifold's drift. | Answered |
| [QUESTION-292](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-292.md) v2 | What evidence would show that a maintaining link, and not a regime's content, keeps a disorder in place: does the efficacy of a treatment that targets the link count, or only change in the link that is specific and comes before the outcome? | The evidential part of [QUESTION-045](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-045.md), split off by the status review of 2026-10-27 under [ADR-049](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-049.md), because [THEORY-053](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-053.md) (Active) settles it. A treatment's efficacy is not evidence for its theory of change. Only change in the theorised process that is specific and comes before the outcome bears on it, and moving the process without moving the outcome counts against the theory. | Answered |
| [QUESTION-306](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-306.md) | Across many artworks of one crowd-built canvas, do placements follow revisions of each artwork's design made or approved by a small identifiable set of accounts, rather than the designs recording what placers had already done, and does the coordination record assign to other groups placements that a behaviour-only method gives to one? | The promotion condition formerly on [THEORY-218](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-218.md), moved here when the tenth status review narrowed [THEORY-218](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-218.md) to the one artwork it studied and promoted it, as [THEORY-285](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-285.md)'s moved to [QUESTION-303](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-303.md). | [QUESTION-319](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-319.md) | Where an organization's parts are related by transports established independently of the analysis, and those transports have nontrivial holonomy, is the holonomy an error the organization tends to remove, or a persistent feature it maintains, and does its pattern predict the organization's response to intervention beyond what its pairwise relations and its dynamics predict? | From A2 §5 of the exchange "Paper assessment" (2026-10-28 to 29), which inverted [LIT-1820](../../../record/literature.d/LIT-1820.md)'s use of holonomy as an error signal: "What if it is a persistent feature of the organization itself?" | [QUESTION-320](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-320.md) | Do the precursors of abrupt overthrow found for crowd-maintained images on r/place (plural, partly the defenders' restoring, accepting and coordinating, and absent for many overthrows) hold in a second collectively maintained system with its own record of attacks and repairs? | The promotion condition formerly on [THEORY-214](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-214.md), moved here when the twelfth status review narrowed [THEORY-214](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-214.md) to what Falmagne, Stephenson and Levin measured on r/place and promoted it, as [THEORY-216](../../../record/theory.d/THEORY-216.md)'s moved to [QUESTION-169](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-169.md). | [QUESTION-324](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-324.md) | Are the conditions an effective description is asked to meet (predictive sufficiency, dynamical independence, memory closure, approximation fidelity, tractability) of one logical kind, or are some of them parameters of the regime under which the others are assessed rather than conditions in their own right? | The last clause of [QUESTION-252](../../../record/questions.d/QUESTION-252.md), split off by the thirteenth status review under [ADR-049](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-049.md) because [CLAIM-401](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-401.md) (Active) settles it: they are not of one kind.
